_purpose: Small 2-round golden dataset smoke run using aeonisk-llm-proxy. DM uses OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini; player and enemy agents use Gemini gemini-3.5-flash.
scenario_hint: Golden dataset smoke scenario. A small Freeborn salvage team reaches a contested undercity waystation where a neutral supply trader is selling scarce medkits and void scanners. A Pantheon reclamation patrol arrives to seize the same cache. Run a focused two-round scene that includes vendor interaction pressure, enemy-agent tactical decisions, targeting, resource tradeoffs, and mechanically grounded consequences.

scenario.situation: The team has minutes to buy supplies and secure a sealed cache before Pantheon reclamation drones and enforcers take control of the market concourse.
environmental_factors: Crowded vendor stalls provide partial cover
A sealed salvage cache hums with unstable void residue
Neutral civilians scatter when weapons are drawn
Pantheon forces want the cache intact

starting_clocks.name: Pantheon Lockdown
starting_clocks.description: Pantheon forces are closing the waystation. At 6 ticks, blast doors seal and the cache is confiscated.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: the lockdown tightens and escape routes close
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: the team disrupts or delays the lockdown

starting_clocks.name: Vendor Panic
starting_clocks.description: The neutral vendor is close to fleeing. At 4 ticks, the vendor shutters the stall and evacuates.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: the vendor loses confidence and prepares to leave
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: the team reassures or protects the vendor

initial_enemies.name: Pantheon Reclamation Patrol
initial_enemies.description: Armored reclamation troops using stun carbines and lockout tags to seize contraband salvage.

initial_enemies.name: Survey Drone
initial_enemies.description: A hovering survey drone projecting target boxes and transmitting lockdown telemetry.

players.name: Ash Mercer
goals: Buy or barter for a void scanner before the vendor flees
Open the salvage cache without worsening the void residue
Keep civilians and the vendor out of the line of fire

players.name: Mira Vale
goals: Hold Pantheon forces away from the vendor and cache
Use nonlethal force where possible to avoid civilian escalation
Extract Ash, the cache, and useful supplies before lockdown

initial_npcs.name: Supply Trader Vex
initial_npcs.description: A grizzled trader with cybernetic eyes and an ACG surplus coat, guarding a portable stall of medical supplies and salvage tools.

vendor_inventory.name: Void Scanner
vendor_inventory.description: Handheld detector for unstable void residue.

vendor_inventory.name: Shock Baton
vendor_inventory.description: Nonlethal close-range weapon useful for disabling patrol units.

initial_npcs.vendor_greeting: Buy fast. Pantheon is already sweeping the lower levels.
